newsitem.title: USA: Purity Supreme ups and extends note tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Purity Supreme ups and extends note tender offer.

text.p: Purity Supreme Inc said on Friday it extended and increased its cash tender offer to repurchase all of its outstanding 11-3/4 percent senior secured notes due 1999.
The offer price has been increased from $1,075 to $1,077.50 per $1000 principal amount, plus accrued and unpaid interest up to but not including the date of acceptance.
In addition, the offer has been extended to expire at 1700 EST/2200 GMT on November 1, 1996, instead of on October 21.

The company said approximately $23.59 million of $118.01 million outstanding notes had been tendered under the intial offer price. Holders of previously tendered notes will receive the increased offer consideration, the company said.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp was acting as dealer manager for the offer, it said.
